meta.title: Daily token usage
meta.description: Shows daily token usage with a per-model breakdown, counted from the session logs on this machine. A sidebar-foot button shows today's total and pops a compact panel with a model-share donut, a 14-day trend chart and a one-click CSV export. Settings gains a Usage statistics page: a five-cell summary strip (total, peak day, today, current and longest daily streaks), WoW/YoY comparison cards, a full-year blue GitHub-style token activity heatmap whose cells are clickable, a closed distribution ring showing today's (or the clicked day's) per-model token split with animated arcs, a 7/30/90-day or custom-date range, a smooth per-model daily trend chart with hover detail, a per-route input/output/cache/calls/share table, and CSV/JSON export. Cold folds read only the newest events from local logs; nothing is sent elsewhere.
